key_insight: A single C++ quantum-inspired evolutionary optimizer can be compiled once and reused across OpenMP, CUDA, HIP, Python, MATLAB, and Julia interfaces without changing the core algorithm.
engineering_relevance: The framework improves runtime portability and makes high-performance optimization easier to deploy across heterogeneous CPU and GPU systems in real engineering workflows.
method: Single-source-of-truth C++ QIEO core compiled per backend
Runtime dispatch across sequential CPU, OpenMP 5, CUDA, and HIP targets
Thin language bindings expose the same solver to Python, MATLAB, and Julia
evidence_signal: The abstract reports practical validation on MNIST hyperparameter tuning, wind farm layout optimization, and Lotka--Volterra parameter estimation, with results including 88.60% test accuracy, 365,399 ± 4,552 MWh/yr, and a 2.1× mean SSE reduction.
watch_item: Portability depends on backend-specific tuning of memory access and parallel execution, so performance and behavior may vary across hardware and bindings.
paper_title: Cross-Backend QIEO: Universal Runtime Portability across OpenMP5, CUDA, HIP, and Multi-Language Interfaces
